# Calculate item-level agreement

```{r}
library(matrixStats)
iagree <- function(item) {
  rowagree <- vector(mode="list", length=length(itemdata))
  
  for (i in 1:length(itemdata)) {
    # 1. Clean data and select the specific item (row)
    ds <- itemdata[[i]] %>% 
      mutate(across(everything(), ~toupper(replace_na(as.character(.), "MISSING"))))
    
    row_data <- ds[item, ]
    
    # 2. Identify Rater Columns (Excluding the first column which is usually the Item ID)
    raters <- row_data[, -1] 
    
    # 3. Dynamic Denominator: n * (n - 1)
    # n is the count of valid (non-MISSING) rater entries
    n <- sum(raters != "MISSING")
    denom <- n * (n - 1)
    
    # 4. Calculate Numerators dynamically for each possible category
    # Formula: sum( x * (x - 1) ) where x is the count of each category
    categories <- c("YES", "NOT PRESENT", "NO")
    
    numerators <- sapply(categories, function(cat) {
      x <- sum(raters == cat)
      return(x * (x - 1))
    })
    
    # 5. Calculate agreement for this row
    # Use an if-check to handle rows with 0 or 1 rater to avoid division by zero
    if (denom > 0) {
      rowagree[[i]] <- sum(numerators) / denom
    } else {
      rowagree[[i]] <- NA
    }
  }
  
  # Final formatting
  agree_df <- do.call(rbind, rowagree) %>% as.data.frame()
  meanagree <- mean(agree_df[[1]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sdagree <- sd(agree_df[[1]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data.frame(item = ds[item, 1], agreement = meanagree, sd = sdagree)
}
```

```{r}
# Select only articles with 3 human reviewers
itemdata <- alldata[-c(16,17,29)]

#Calculate item agreement scores
listagree <- lapply(1:69, iagree)

#Transform to data frame
all <- listagree %>% melt() %>% pivot_wider(id_cols=Number, names_from=variable, values_from=value)

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)

# 1. Define the core calculation logic for a single row
calc_row_stats <- function(row_subset) {
  vals <- as.character(row_subset)
  vals <- vals[vals != "MISSING" & !is.na(vals) & vals != ""]
  n <- length(vals)
  if (n < 2) return(NA)
  
  denom <- n * (n - 1)
  nums <- sapply(c("YES", "NOT PRESENT", "NO"), function(cat) {
    x <- sum(vals == cat)
    x * (x - 1)
  })
  return(sum(nums) / denom)
}

# 2. Process all dataframes in the itemdata list
all_results <- map_dfr(itemdata, function(ds) {
  
  # Ensure data is clean (standardize to Uppercase)
  ds <- ds %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~toupper(as.character(.))))
  
  # Calculate for each row in this specific dataframe
  # Assuming: Col 1 = ID, Cols 2-4 = Humans, Cols 5-7 = AI (OC, AC, GG)
  rowwise_stats <- map_dfr(1:nrow(ds), function(i) {
    data.frame(
      item_id   = ds[i, 1],
      h_h_agree = calc_row_stats(ds[i, 2:4]),
      a_a_agree = calc_row_stats(ds[i, 5:7]),
      total_agree = calc_row_stats(ds[i, 2:7])
    )
  })
  
  return(rowwise_stats)
})

# 3. Calculate Global Averages
summary_stats <- all_results %>%
  summarise(
    mean_human_human = mean(h_h_agree, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ai_ai       = mean(a_a_agree, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_total       = mean(total_agree, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_total         = sd(total_agree, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_items          = n()
  )

print(summary_stats)
```
